podcast.body: Lynn Anderson's album "Rose Garden" was a massive success, reaching number one on the country album chart for 14 consecutive weeks. This achievement was unmatched by another female artist until Shania Twain's "The Woman in Me" 25 years later. "The album was number one on the country album chart for 14 weeks in a row and the next woman to do better than that was Shenaya Twain with the woman in me and that was 25 years later."
